program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((hh (rows g))
                  (ww (cols g))
                  (noise 6)
                  (found #f)
                  (tile-pr 1)
                  (tile-pc 1)
                  (tile (make-hash)))
             (for ((pr (range 1 (+ 1 (quotient hh 2)))))
               (unless
                 found
                 (for ((pc (range 1 (+ 1 (quotient ww 2)))))
                   (unless
                     found
                     (let ((t (make-hash))
                           (ok #t)
                           (complete #t))
                       (for* ((r (range 0 hh)) (c (range 0 ww)))
                             (when
                               ok
                               (let ((v (at g r c)))
                                 (when
                                   (!= v noise)
                                   (let ((tr (remainder r pr))
                                         (tc (remainder c pc)))
                                     (cond
                                       ((not (hash-has-key? t (list tr tc))) (hash-set! t (list tr tc) v))
                                       ((!= (hash-ref t (list tr tc) 0) v) (set! ok #f))))))))
                       (when
                         ok
                         (for* ((tr (range 0 pr)) (tc (range 0 pc)))
                               (unless
                                 (hash-has-key? t (list tr tc))
                                 (set! complete #f))))
                       (when
                         (and ok complete)
                         (set! found #t)
                         (set! tile-pr pr)
                         (set! tile-pc pc)
                         (set! tile t)))))))
             (build-grid hh
                         ww
                         (r c)
                         (hash-ref tile
                                   (list (remainder r tile-pr) (remainder c tile-pc))
                                   0))))))
